content:
VIEWE UEDX12120076-HMD-RB-A and UEDX80800076-HMD-RB-A are 7.6-inch square HDMI capacitive touch displays with 1200×1200 and 800×800 resolution, respectively. We had previously seen 4-inch square HDMI +USB touch displays with 720×720 resolution for Raspberry Pi or other SBCs, but if you need something larger, VIEWE has now launched 7.6-inch variants with higher resolutions. VIEWE UEDX12120076-HMD-RB-A/UEDX80800076-HMD specifications: Display 7.6-inch MIPI DSI square IPS display Resolution UEDX80800076-HMD-RB-A – 800 x 800 UEDX12120076-HMD-RB-A – 1200 x 1200 Display driver ILI9881C for UEDX80800076-HMD-RB-A Potentially HX8279 for UEDX12120076-HMD-RB-A Brightness – 1,000 cd/㎡ Active area – 135.36 x 135.36 mm Touchscreen – Optional 5-point capacitive touchscreen via USB-C port (likely FT6336U touch IC) Video Input Mini HDMI 1.4 ITE HDMI input to MIPI DSI bridge based on the blurry photo of the controller. USB – USB-C port for power and touchscreen Misc – LED lifetime: 30,000 hours Power Supply – 5V via USB-C port Dimensions – 148.24 x [...]
